key_lessons_for_next_sessions: Pre-amend ⚠-user-approval criteria from 'recorded as a comment' to 'recorded in description as ## Approval section' BEFORE dispatching the issue. Saves a rework cycle.
Reviewer LLM is stochastic on the comment-vs-description-edit reading: D2 accepted same-pattern fix; D3 rejected 3 times. Pre-amendment removes the ambiguity.

dev/research/<crate>/ stubs need a .gitignore for `target/` and `Cargo.lock` BEFORE the first commit. Otherwise build artefacts pollute history (also captured in feedback_dev_research_target_gitignore memory).
The strict-reading reviewer pattern: when criterion uses 'the only X required' or 'X is THE Y', expect strict-not-permissive interpretation. Reword criterion or escalate amendment.
